thread:
Aisha (CSM): quick triage — Catalyst org (acct: catalyst-inc) shows ~68% drop in API calls MoM, most severe in embeddings and batch inference endpoints. procurement lead swapped to Lena last week per notes; no meetings on calendar. also flagged: one seat freeze request from ops. possible competitive eval (PilotAI) spotted via webhooks. can we assemble a rapid playbook?
Marco (Account Exec): on it. I'll ping Lena and try to get a read on procurement timeline. do we have raw 90d activity + top 5 endpoints? want to see if it's front-end usage or backend batch jobs.
Priya (Solutions Eng): grabbing logs now. quick datapoint: I see a cluster of failed embedding jobs around 2024-10-04 02:15 UTC — retries up, error rate spike ~12%. could explain drop if their ingestion pipelines backed off.
Priya (Solutions Eng): SQL I ran to get daily token totals:```SELECT day, SUM(tokens_processed) as total_tokens FROM usage_events WHERE account_id='catalyst-inc' AND day >= '2024-07-01' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day;``` share results in a sec.
billing-bot: Invoice #C-2024-09 for catalyst-inc is due in 7 days. Amount: $12,540.27
Theo (Product): heads-up — we rolled quantization profile v2 for opt-family models on 2024-09-20. if their workloads use that model, there could be perf/quality regressions for some prompts. any signal about model id usage?
Aisha (CSM): good catch. Priya — can you correlate failed jobs with model_id and quant profile? Marco — if procurement timeline is <=60 days we treat as renewal-risk.
Priya (Solutions Eng): correlated — most failed jobs hit model_id: redwood-embed-v3, and the client is hitting the batch endpoint with 50k-item jobs. failures are HTTP 503 from our batch worker pool (throttled). quant profile likely unrelated for embeddings but could impact gen endpoints.
Marco (Account Exec): Lena responded: procurement evaluating options, decision target ~end of quarter (30 days). Champion (Samir) still engaged but quiet. Lena asked for pricing and SLA evidence.
Aisha (CSM): summary + proposed action items: 1) Ops scrub: prioritize embedding batch retries + increase burst capacity for 72h to clear backlog (Priya/Eng). 2) Outreach: Marco to schedule 1:1 with Lena + involve Samir. 3) Short-term offer: 2-week complimentary dedicated burst + a pre-recorded QBR focused on performance/cost comparisons. 4) Longer-term: propose a dedicated trial (Reserved capacity) with performance SLOs and a migration plan if they want on-prem later.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I can provision a temporary burst pool and adjust batch concurrency. ETA 2h to start; will post logs.
Theo (Product): Product can prep a short perf deck showing before/after quant/throughput + suggested model alternatives (e.g., redwood-embed-lite). I'll have slides by tomorrow EOD.
Marco (Account Exec): will ask Lena if we can demo the burst impact this week. proposing Wed 10/11 or Thu 10/12.
Aisha (CSM): ok — meeting ask: 30m technical + 15m procurement. Marco book; include Priya + Theo. I'll invite Samir too.
Aisha (CSM): quick customer-facing summary to send after internal alignment: "We're seeing ingestion throttles causing embedding failures; immediate fix: temporary burst allocation + ops changes to retry logic. We'll demonstrate impact and share a tailored cost/SLA proposal." Thoughts?
Marco (Account Exec): wording good. add a line: "No changes to customer data location or policies; this is a transient capacity change." helps reassure procurement.
Priya (Solutions Eng): agree. also include suggested quick test: run 5k-item batch in staging to validate.
billing-bot: Note: Past due notifications may affect procurement cadence. Consider fast-tracking billing questions if needed.
Aisha (CSM): action tracker: Marco book meeting (By EOD today). Priya spin up burst + post logs (start within 2h). Theo deliver perf slides (tomorrow EOD). I'll draft customer note and share before meeting. We'll reconvene in this thread after Marco confirms time. :thumbsup:
Marco (Account Exec): booked Wed 10/11 16:00 PT. invite sent to Lena, Samir, Aisha, Priya, Theo.
Priya (Solutions Eng): started burst provisioning — capacity increased, batch workers scaling. initial logs: error rate down 75% in first 30m. will attach traces to the calendar invite.
Aisha (CSM): amazing — keep this thread updated with attachments. if we see recovery, consider offering a pro-rated credit rather than discount to keep dollars flowing.
Theo (Product): noted. prepping alternate model suggestions and a short A/B plan for the demo.
Aisha (CSM): thanks everyone. I'll queue a short pre-read for Lena that includes the billing note + technical mitigation. reconvene after meeting. :handshake:
